blurb: The Lymph Current offers manual lymphatic drainage and specialized post-surgical care including fibrosis treatment and C-section scar massage. Sessions use gentle, rhythmic, pathway-based hands-on techniques to support lymphatic fluid movement and recovery after surgery or for chronic swelling. Care is personalized based on the client's condition, procedure history, and recovery stage.
